# Phone photo fixtures

Synthetic 96 × 64 two-color images, generated for this repository using Pillow
and pillow-heif. HEIC uses HEVC encoding. The JPEG has EXIF orientation 6 and
must display as 64 × 96. These files contain no personal photos or metadata.
They exercise formats and orientation; they do not replace testing on physical
iPhones and Android phones with full-resolution camera photos.
